Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestDiscordianChronology_test_until_DAYS.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestDiscordianChronology/TestDiscordianChronology_test_until_DAYS.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The original test only exercises `test_until_DAYS`, which uses `data_samples`. All the other data-provider methods and most imports are dead code that obscures intent. Let me write a focused, readable version.Compilation succeeded (`COMPILE_OK`). I improved understandability by removing the dozen unused data-provider methods and ~40 dead imports, keeping only `data_samples` (renamed to `data_equivalentDates`) and the single `test_until_DAYS` test it actually drives—plus added clarifying Javadoc and aligned the date pairs into a readable table. Runtime behaviour is unchanged: the same `DiscordianDate.of(...)`/`until(..., DAYS)` calls run with identical arguments and expected results.
